sn47.42:1.1: “Bhikkhus, I will teach you the origination and the passing away of the four establishments of mindfulness.
sn47.42:1.3: “And what, bhikkhus, is the origination of the body?
sn47.42:1.4: With the origination of nutriment there is the origination of the body.
sn47.42:1.5: With the cessation of nutriment there is the passing away of the body.
sn47.42:1.6: “With the origination of contact there is the origination of feeling.
sn47.42:1.7: With the cessation of contact there is the passing away of feeling.
sn47.42:1.8: “With the origination of name-and-form there is the origination of mind.
sn47.42:1.9: With the cessation of name-and-form there is the passing away of mind.
sn47.42:1.10: “With the origination of attention there is the origination of phenomena.
sn47.42:1.11: With the cessation of attention there is the passing away of phenomena.”
